dslRule:
<!id: eclipse-shared-image-constants>
<!description: Replaces specific ISharedImages constants with their updated or correct counterparts. This fixes common UI icon issues by mapping old/incorrect image IDs to the intended ones.
>
<!severity: HINT>
<!tags: eclipse-ui, constant-replacement, image-descriptor>

<!map IMAGE_REPLACEMENT: "IMG_TOOL_DELETE_DISABLED" => "IMG_ELCL_REMOVE_DISABLED", "IMG_TOOL_DELETE" => "IMG_ELCL_REMOVE">

$receiver.getImageDescriptor(org.eclipse.ui.ISharedImages.#{IMAGE_REPLACEMENT})
=>
$receiver.getImageDescriptor(org.eclipse.ui.ISharedImages.#{IMAGE_REPLACEMENT_VALUE})
;;
summary: Replace IMG_TOOL_DELETE_DISABLED with IMG_ELCL_REMOVE_DISABLED and IMG_TOOL_DELETE with IMG_ELCL_REMOVE in calls to ISharedImages.getImageDescriptor.

verification.message: Candidate DSL must contain only one rule and optional per-rule metadata; file metadata, includes, and embedded Java are not promotable
